settings.title: Base Pill Pod
settings.description: Stores larger daily capsules and tablets. Divided into 3 sections with a dispensing mechanism for easy access. Large pill pod: 1.5 in. tall.
settings.features:
7-day supplement capacity
Organized compartments
Easy access dispenser

settings.title: Compact Pill Pod
settings.description: Designed for smaller daily supplements. Includes divider for two smaller pill sections. Small Pill pod: 0.75 in. tall.
settings.features:
Compact capsule storage
Sealed container
Travel-friendly size

settings.title: Powder Pod
settings.description: Stores powder servings such as creatine, electrolytes, or greens. Includes scoop and can be stacked with additional pods if needed. Powder pod: 2.5 in. tall.
settings.features:
Multiple scoop capacity
Airtight seal
Wide opening for filling
